termsDialog.title: Welcome to Lockari Vault!
termsDialog.introduction: Before you begin, please take a moment to review our terms. Lockari Vault is a platform designed to securely store and manage your secrets, keys, and certificates, ensuring your digital assets are protected.
termsDialog.securityPledge: We are committed to your security. All data stored on our platform is encrypted using industry best practices. Your sensitive information is never stored in plaintext.
termsDialog.agreementClause: By clicking 'Accept and Continue', you confirm that you have read and agree to the following points:
items: You agree to use the platform and acknowledge that we will securely store your data to provide our services.
You understand that all sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account password.
You agree not to use the platform for any illegal or unauthorized purpose.
We will make reasonable efforts to ensure the platform is available, but do not guarantee uninterrupted service.
We may update the platform and its services from time to time to improve functionality and security.
We will never sell your personal data, such as your email address, to third parties.
For paid plans, we use a leading, secure payment processor. Your card details are never stored on our servers.
You can export your data at any time, subject to your plan's features.
You can cancel your subscription at any time. There are no long-term contracts or lock-in periods.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.introduction: Welcome to Lockari Vault. These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your access to and use of the Lockari Vault services, website, and applications (collectively, the 'Platform'). By using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: 1. Introduction to the Platform
sections.content: Lockari Vault provides a secure environment for managing digital secrets, including but not limited to API keys, passwords, certificates, and SSH keys. Our goal is to provide a reliable and secure service following the best market practices for cybersecurity.

sections.title: 2. Security and Data Encryption
sections.content: We are committed to the security of your data. All information you store on the Platform is encrypted at rest and in transit using strong encryption protocols. Sensitive data is never stored in plaintext format, ensuring that only you can access your secrets.

agreement.title: 3. User Agreement
agreement.description: By creating an account and using the Platform, you acknowledge and agree to the following points:
items: You agree to use the platform and are aware that we securely store your data to provide our services.
You understand that all sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and never stored in plaintext.
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account password and for all activities that occur under your account.
You agree not to use the Platform for any illegal or unauthorized purpose and to comply with all local laws regarding online conduct.
We will make reasonable efforts to ensure that the platform is available, but we do not guarantee an uninterrupted or error-free service.
We may update the Platform and its services from time to time to improve functionality, security, and user experience.
We will never sell your personal data, such as your name or email address, to third parties. Our business model is based on providing a valuable service, not on monetizing user data.
For paid plans, we use a leading, secure payment processor (e.g., Stripe, PayPal). Your financial details are securely handled by them and are never stored on our servers.
You have the right to export your data at any time, subject to the features of your subscription plan, allowing you full control over your information.
You can cancel your subscription at any time. We do not enforce long-term contracts or lock-in periods, providing you with maximum flexibility.
